summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Charles Robert Woods (February 19, 1827 – February 26, 1885), a career United States Army officer who became a Union general in the American Civil War. It highlights his command of the relief troops that first tried to resupply Fort Sumter before the conflict began, and notes his distinguished wartime service.
one_line: Biography of Charles Robert Woods, a career U.S. Army officer and Union general who led early attempts to resupply Fort Sumter.
